description: This Java class defines a REST controller named HelloController with endpoints for greeting, documentation redirect, health status, and application info, utilizing Spring Boot annotations and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for welcome, documentation redirection, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when accessing the root endpoint.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request's URL scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple string indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic information about the application.
